speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Scabies.

Based on your recent travel to a crowded conference in Miami, your history of diabetes (which can alter immune response), and the intense itching with red bumps, I am highly suspicious of scabies infestation. Do you notice any burrows (tiny, wavy lines) or intense itching that worsens at night?
